hooks.name: Declarative and catalog gate on stop
hooks.description: Report-only final gate when the agent stops: no chapter/level/comix page named in code, and compiled chapter & comix catalogs match disk. Runs every step, prints a FAILED line per failing step, always exits 0. Under 1 s.

action.command: f=0; for c in 'node scripts/quality/check-declarative.mjs' 'node scripts/harness/generate-chapter.mjs --check' 'node scripts/harness/generate-comix.mjs --check'; do sh -c "$c" 2>&1 || { f=$((f+1)); echo "FAILED (report-only): run $c"; }; done; if [ "$f" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'chapter gates: all steps passed'; else echo "chapter gates: $f step(s) FAILED (report-only, see above)"; fi; exit 0
